coveringUcs.assuranceRationale: Phase-C authored UC targeting AU Privacy Act APP 11 (Security of personal information). Uses continuous, production-grade Splunk telemetry to provide auditor-facing evidence; assurance level set to 'contributing' pending SME review per Phase E of the regulation-coverage plan.
coveringUcs.controlObjective: Evidence that AU Privacy Act APP 11 (Security of personal information) is enforced — Splunk UC-22.50.1: APP 11 personal-information security — continuous evidence of protective controls.
coveringUcs.evidenceArtifact: Saved search 'UC-22.50.1' running on catalogue-defined data sources (see UC detailedImplementation), archived to the restricted audit_evidence index (default 7-year retention). Auto-drafted — SME review required.
coveringUcs.smeCaveat: Phase-C draft: SME review required before uplifting assurance from 'contributing' to 'partial' or 'full'. Confirm that the SPL captures the specific regulator expectation and that the telemetry exists in the deployment.
coveringUcs.ucTitle: APP 11 personal-information security — continuous evidence of protective controls

gapNote: AU Privacy Act clause APP 11 has only contributing or detection-mode coverage. A primary (assurance=full or partial, mode=satisfies) UC is still needed to close the clause.
regulationName: Australian Privacy Act 1988 and Notifiable Data Breaches scheme
